headline: The World Bank urged Pakistan to move from stabilisation to investment-led growth in a meeting with Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb, who said Pakistan regained market access through a $3 billion Eurobond.

card.desc: Move from stabilisation to investment-led, private sector growth.

caption:
The World Bank has urged Pakistan to move from stabilisation to sustainable, investment-led growth driven by the private sector, Dawn reports. Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb told World Bank officials Pakistan has regained access to international markets through a $3 billion Eurobond, Business Recorder adds.
